title: Growth config: INTEGRATION
description: Non-secret settings of the read-only marketing integrations (GRW-P2-F), keyed by integration kind: mode, secretRef names, account label, pull schedule, rate budget and retention. secrets are never stored, only their names. Integrations never create or edit anything on an external platform (AD-1). Added in contracts 1.12.0. Every default is PROPOSED_DEFAULT until the founder ratifies it. Unknown keys are rejected; secrets are never stored here, only secretRef names.

propertyNames.description: Integration kind: googleads, searchconsole, ga4, playconsole, appstoreconnect, metaads, tiktok, whatsappcloud, fcmapns, crux or a kind added later.

mode.description: PROPOSED_DEFAULT mock. real is never exercised in CI.

secretRef.description: NAME of a secret in the secrets store, never the value.

accountLabel.description: Display label of the account (never an id or a secret).

integrations.description: Settings per integration kind, keyed by kind. One version covers every integration of the scope; the platform flag growth.integrations.<kind> still switches each one.
